data.name: Revenge: Rhobar's myth
data.detailed_description:
A MAGICAL WORLD FULL OF WITCHCRAFT AND WIZARDRY AWAITS YOU!


Join the worlds best wizard academy and embark on an exciting, mysterious journey. Learn 4 different and mighty spells to change the world around you, experience a breathtaking plot about the lost wizard Rhobar or challenge yourself in the freeroam mode! Combine the use of the 4 unique Spells Auraco, Luminos, Terramus and Ignis so solve magical puzzles and find the ideal route in the Spell-Challenges. Set your own highscore and rise the bar for other wizards to a new level.

FEATURES:
  • Gameplay specifically designed for PC
  • 2 game modes - Freeroam & Story
  • Open world experience with no loading pauses
  • Use combinations of your spells to solve magic puzzles
  • Modern graphics by Unreal Engine 3 and high resolution Textures
  • Epic Soundtrack by Kevin MacLeod
  • DRM free & only free DLCs
  • 4k Support

reviews.review:
Revenge: Rhobar’s Myth is a fantasy adventure game developed and published by Polygon Art that places players in the role of an aspiring wizard exploring a magical world filled with mysteries, ancient secrets, and spell-based challenges. Built around the concept of becoming a student at a renowned academy of magic, the game delivers an experience that combines exploration, puzzle-solving, and open-world discovery rather than focusing exclusively on combat. Its premise is simple yet appealing, inviting players to uncover the legend of the enigmatic wizard Rhobar while mastering a variety of magical abilities along the way.

The strongest aspect of the game is its emphasis on magic as a gameplay tool. Instead of treating spells as mere weapons, Revenge: Rhobar’s Myth integrates them into nearly every part of the adventure. Players gain access to several unique magical powers that can be used to interact with the environment, solve puzzles, and reach previously inaccessible areas. This approach creates a sense of progression that feels rewarding because every newly learned spell expands the possibilities for exploration. The game encourages experimentation, allowing players to think creatively about how different magical abilities can be used to overcome obstacles scattered throughout the world.

Exploration plays a central role in the overall experience. The game presents a large fantasy landscape that rewards curiosity with hidden locations, environmental puzzles, and story-related discoveries. The open-world design creates a feeling of freedom that is often uncommon in smaller independent projects. Rather than guiding players through a strictly linear path, the game allows them to wander through magical environments, uncover secrets at their own pace, and immerse themselves in the atmosphere of a world shaped by ancient wizardry. This freedom helps make the adventure feel personal and encourages repeated visits to previously explored regions once new spells have been acquired.

The narrative revolves around the mystery of Rhobar, a legendary wizard whose story gradually unfolds as players progress. While the plot is not particularly complex, it serves its purpose by providing motivation and context for the adventure. The journey from student magician to powerful spellcaster is supported by a steady flow of discoveries that help maintain interest throughout the campaign. The storytelling focuses more on atmosphere and world-building than on intricate character development, making the game feel like a magical quest driven by curiosity and exploration rather than dramatic narrative twists.

Visually, the game delivers a respectable presentation for an independent title built on Unreal Engine 3. The environments feature colorful landscapes, mystical structures, and fantasy-themed locations that successfully capture the spirit of a magical world. Although the graphics naturally show their age compared to more recent releases, the artistic direction remains effective in creating an immersive setting. High-resolution textures and support for modern display resolutions help the game remain visually accessible even years after its original release. The world itself feels crafted with care, emphasizing atmosphere over technical spectacle.

The audio design complements the adventure well, particularly through its musical score. The soundtrack enhances the sense of wonder that accompanies exploration and discovery, helping transform simple journeys across the landscape into memorable moments. Combined with ambient environmental sounds, the music contributes significantly to the game's overall charm and reinforces the fantasy setting. Whether exploring a hidden corner of the world or solving a magical puzzle, the audio presentation consistently supports the experience.

Despite its strengths, Revenge: Rhobar’s Myth does reveal some limitations associated with its indie origins. Certain gameplay elements can become repetitive over time, especially for players expecting extensive combat systems or deep role-playing mechanics. The puzzles, while enjoyable, occasionally rely on familiar patterns, and some aspects of the presentation lack the polish found in larger-budget productions. Character interactions and storytelling can also feel somewhat basic, leaving portions of the world underdeveloped compared to the game's ambitious setting.

Even with these shortcomings, the game succeeds in offering a distinctive fantasy adventure centered on magic, exploration, and discovery. Its willingness to focus on spell-based interaction rather than constant combat gives it a unique identity within the genre. Players who enjoy wandering through magical worlds, solving environmental puzzles, and uncovering hidden secrets will likely find plenty to appreciate. While it may not reach the depth or refinement of major fantasy releases, Revenge: Rhobar’s Myth delivers an enjoyable and imaginative journey that demonstrates the creativity behind Polygon Art’s vision.

Rating: 5/10
